veranderings.rede: The centre closed after the money had run out, so the completed past form reads more precisely in this past-tense story.

veranderings.voor: en die skool vertel dat Nkosi MIV het
veranderings.na: en vir die skool vertel dat Nkosi MIV het
veranderings.rede: With a noun as the person told, 'vir die skool vertel' is the more natural Afrikaans; the protected word 'vertel' stays.

vlae.teks: Hy het gevra dat almal dieselfde behandel word.
vlae.rede: Vague for a Grade 5 reader: it does not say who should be treated the same as whom, and 'behandel' is used later in the medical sense ('Vandag word MIV ook behandel'). Making it clearer means stating the intended content, so it is flagged rather than changed.

vlae.teks: Daardie reël het gesê 'n openbare skool mag nie 'n kind met MIV wegwys nie. In Suid-Afrika mag geen openbare skool 'n kind wegwys omdat die kind MIV het nie.
vlae.rede: Two sentences in a row say almost the same thing, which reads as repetition. Both carry protected wording or touch a fact-checked claim, so this is left to the writer rather than changed.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: The entry says HOU 'VIGS', but the lesson, the glossary headword and the shared definition all write 'vigs' in lower case, which matches the AWS spelling. Nothing was changed; it may be worth making the entry's spelling match so nobody 'corrects' the lesson to capitals.
